0022600220.text: The Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest), with Chicago on a six-game losing streak and San Antonio riding an eight-game winning streak. Chicago is without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the season series 0-2, including a 129-114 loss in San Antonio.
